str.text: Erreur de communication sur le port %1. Erreur d'envoi des données.
str.desc: Error sending data. %1 = description of port.

str.text: Erreur de communication sur le port %1. Le système n'a pas encore initialisé les services de communication.
str.desc: Failed to perform functionality since flow control is not initialized. %1 = description of port.

str.text: Erreur de communication sur le port %1. La mémoire d'envoi est pleine.
str.desc: Failed to send data due to max buffer size being reached. %1 = description of port.

str.text: Erreur de communication sur le port %2. Un paquet avec l'ID %1 a expiré.
str.desc: A packet timed out when waiting for a response. %1 = packet identifier. %2 = description of port

str.text: Communication error on port %1. An error has occurred while processing received data. %2
str.desc: Failed to process data received on the port. %1 = description of port. %2 = Further details about the error.
